statement: Implement one canonical artifact ingestion and identity-only deployment mechanism (PUBLISH SERVICE ARTIFACT and lagrange service publish), monotonic service binding revision updates with in-flight request pinning and canonical JSON request-body delivery, end-to-end developer journeys (J1, J2, J3) and existing-Kubernetes/cloud deployment guides, pure evidence-projection comparison renderers with original-evidence admission, and reconcile capabilities, roadmaps, and superseded benchmark epics.

constraints.statement: Retire artifact_source on INSTALL and UPGRADE, remove Tier 1 disk cache and Tier 3 external repair, require replicated artifactPayloadStore, and ingest artifacts exclusively through PUBLISH SERVICE ARTIFACT $1 and lagrange service publish.

Version bindings monotonically by generation on (tenant_id, binding_name), route new requests to the highest ready generation while pinning in-flight requests, and normalize HTTP JSON object and empty bodies to a single request envelope.

Remove modeled, oracle, and constant-derived numbers from all static comparison renderers, enforce validateOriginalReceiptAdmission in comparative-matrix-runner.js, and update comparative-benchmark-matrix-guard.js and distributed-scaleout-provenance-guard.js.
Spawn an independent subagent verifier to audit the diff and test evidence before landing, and record its approval with --verifier subagent:<id> --verdict approve.
